title: Angles and Parallel Lines
summary: Vertically opposite and linear pairs; corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 5: Parallel and Intersecting Lines
Earlier NCERT Ch 5: Lines and Angles

objectives: I can find angles using vertically opposite angles and linear pairs.
I can identify corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles.
I can use angle facts to check whether lines are parallel.
misconceptions: Alternate angles are equal even when lines aren't parallel.
Angle size depends on the length of the arms.
